stories.title: Sunday Gathering artisan market returns to Mold’s Daniel Owen Square
stories.summary: Mold’s Sunday Gathering artisan market returns to Daniel Owen Square on Sunday 27 September, with 33 stalls, a dog show and free school uniforms on offer. stories.title: Greenfield Valley awarded £20,000 to grow its volunteer programme
stories.summary: Greenfield Valley has been awarded £20,000 to pay for more volunteer coordination and recruit new volunteers over the next two years. The money, from Community Lottery, will fund extended support from the valley’s Volunteer Coordinator. stories.title: Concerns that new ‘ethical framework’ to Wales’ defence sector could cost jobs

stories.title: Ewloe homes fight reaches planning inspector as councillor lodges 39-page objection
stories.summary: A Hawarden community councillor has urged a planning inspector to throw out a developer’s appeal over 315 homes on farmland in Ewloe. stories.title: Holywell care home rated excellent by Care Inspectorate Wales
stories.summary: A care home near Holywell for adults with learning disabilities and autism has been rated excellent in three of four areas by Care Inspectorate Wales.
